name: Direction générale de l'Aviation civile
notes: Confirmed on ecologie.gouv.fr (ministry site) as the French national regulatory and safety oversight authority; the DGAC also provides air navigation services through its DSNA service (separate entity fr-dsna). The former dgac.fr / aviation-civile.gouv.fr sites no longer respond. The DGAC pages on ecologie.gouv.fr carry the ministry's own identity and no DGAC logo file or brand page. A search result mentions an internal DGAC 2022 graphic charter; none is public, and Wikimedia files were not used.
